# [TASK] Provide a supported way to provision an ADMIN account

## Task
Provide a supported way to provision an ADMIN account. `AuthService` always registers `Role.USER` and there is no promotion path, so after #237 the gateway's `/admin/**` API has no caller a fresh deployment can produce — the only route today is a manual `UPDATE users SET role = 'ADMIN'`.

## Scope
Provisioning only. The gateway-side rule is done in #237 and is not revisited here.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] A documented, repeatable way to obtain an ADMIN account on a fresh deployment that does not require hand-editing the database (`AdminBootstrapService` + `AdminBootstrapRunner`, driven by `ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_USERNAME`/`_EMAIL`/`_PASSWORD`)
- [x] The mechanism cannot create an admin with a default or empty credential: absent configuration, no admin is created and startup logs that (`AdminBootstrapServiceTest.skipsWhenNothingConfigured` and the partial-config/weak-password variants)
- [x] Tests cover both outcomes at two layers: `AdminBootstrapServiceTest` (14 unit tests, mocked repository) for the validation and creation logic, and `AdminBootstrapIntegrationTest` (configured: real Postgres, login proves the issued token carries `roles: [ADMIN]`) plus `UserServiceIntegrationTest.noAdminBootstrappedWithoutConfig` (unconfigured) for the real Spring context. The two integration tests are not confirmed green in this run; see Notes.
- [x] The interim manual note added to `docs/security/DDOS_PROTECTION_IMPLEMENTED.md` in #237 is replaced with the real procedure
- [ ] `:backend:user-service:test` passes (blocked, see Notes)

## Estimate
**Hours:** 4

## Notes
Approach: seeded-from-config (env vars), not a bootstrap token or promotion endpoint. Matches how other operational secrets in this service are supplied.

The last criterion needs `:backend:user-service:test` green. No sandbox run so far, including this one, has had both a JDK 25 toolchain (`gradle.properties`' `javaVersion`) and Docker network access to pull `postgres:17-alpine` for Testcontainers. Leave this open until a run with both confirms the full suite passes.
